fields.label: User Intent
fields.purpose: Preserve what the user actually requested before intent resolution.
fields.source: Current user trigger
fields.grammar: Verbatim text or a close, meaning-preserving paraphrase.
fields.verification: The user is authoritative for the content of their request; structural presence is mandatory.
fields.mutability: Captured once before reasoning and immutable after capsule open.
fields.failure_condition: Missing or materially altered intent blocks schema compliance.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

examples.valid: Review the repository and propose a slim boot plan.

fields.label: Causal ID
fields.purpose: Bind the capsule to a normalized triggering input.
fields.source: Normalized Trigger field
fields.grammar: SHA-256 digest of the normalized trigger.
fields.verification: Recompute from the normalized trigger and require an exact match.
fields.mutability: Immutable after computation.
fields.failure_condition: Absent, malformed, or mismatched digest blocks capsule opening.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.purpose: Store the normalized input used for causal identity and routing.
fields.source: Current user input or governed kernel event
fields.verification: Must preserve the actionable meaning of User Intent.
fields.mutability: Immutable after Causal ID computation.
fields.failure_condition: Missing trigger or mismatch with Causal ID blocks opening.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Received
fields.purpose: Record when the causal trigger entered the capsule runtime.
fields.source: Runtime clock
fields.verification: Syntax and monotonic session ordering must pass.
fields.mutability: Immutable after capture.
fields.failure_condition: Missing or invalid timestamp blocks schema compliance.
fields.display: Internal; may appear in explicit capsule or audit output.
fields.notes: v3.9 fixed causal-entry order by placing Received before Session Context and IC-Node.

fields.label: Session Context
fields.purpose: Provide a deterministic, read-only session snapshot before intent resolution.
fields.source: KV-Scribe TURN_INDEX, capsule ledger, active mode, mode history, and SESSION_THREAD
fields.grammar: T[N] · CAP-[N] of [total_at_entry] · MODE · optional TRANSITION · SESSION · Thread; CAP-000 uses BOOTSTRAP.
fields.cardinality: Exactly one value, maximum 240 characters; Thread maximum 80 characters.
fields.verification: Compile deterministically from KV-Scribe; no local inference.
fields.mutability: Frozen at causal entry; later child capsules cannot alter it.
fields.failure_condition: Missing callout, overlength value, inferred topic, or use as evidence triggers a governance fault.
fields.display: Projected in the mini-map SCF line and available in explicit capsule output.

examples.valid: T[4] · CAP-004 of 4 · MODE: #mode_literal 🟡 · SESSION: EXPLORATORY · Thread: schema planning
examples.invalid: The user seems focused and wants documentation.

fields.label: IC-Node
fields.purpose: Resolve the active intent into entity, action, and constraint components.
fields.source: User Intent, Trigger, and active verified constraints
fields.verification: Must preserve the request and respect the single-active-intent law.
fields.mutability: May be corrected before reasoning; immutable once reasoning begins.
fields.failure_condition: Ambiguous or multi-intent resolution blocks reasoning until resolved or routed.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: ID
fields.purpose: Give the capsule a unique session identity.
fields.source: Capsule namespace allocator
fields.verification: Must be unique in KV-Scribe and valid for the assigned namespace.
fields.mutability: Immutable after allocation.
fields.failure_condition: Duplicate, missing, or malformed identity blocks opening and seal.
fields.display: Projected in the mini-map and explicit capsule output.

fields.label: Parent Capsule ID
fields.purpose: Declare the immediately preceding sealed capsule in the session chain.
fields.source: Latest sealed KV-Scribe entry; CAP-000 uses the governed boot exception
fields.cardinality: Exactly one for every non-genesis capsule.
fields.verification: KRONOS checks the ID against the latest sealed capsule before reasoning and the closure gate rechecks it.
fields.mutability: Immutable after chain verification.
fields.failure_condition: Missing or non-current parent blocks closure under Universal Parentage.
fields.display: Represented by the parent PoT projection in the mini-map chain.

fields.label: Parent Hash
fields.purpose: Bind the capsule to the previous sealed Proof of Thought.
fields.source: Previous sealed capsule PoT in KV-Scribe
fields.grammar: Previous PoT projected to four characters by the current schema.
fields.cardinality: Exactly one for every non-genesis capsule.
fields.verification: KRONOS requires an exact match to the ledger projection; the closure gate repeats the check.
fields.mutability: Immutable after chain verification.
fields.failure_condition: Missing or mismatched hash blocks opening or closure.
fields.display: Always projected as the left side of the mini-map lineage pair.
fields.notes: This records the current v3.11 schema literally; any move from a four-character projection to a full digest requires a schema change.

fields.label: Name
fields.purpose: Provide the human-readable name of the capsule and its reasoning event.
fields.source: Resolved Goal and capsule context
fields.verification: Must accurately identify the capsule without adding unverified claims.
fields.mutability: May be refined before reasoning; immutable at seal.
fields.failure_condition: Missing or misleading name fails schema review.
fields.display: May appear in mini-map context, TURN_INDEX, and explicit capsule output.

fields.label: Schema Version
fields.purpose: Declare the capsule grammar used for compliance and canonical ordering.
fields.source: Active capsule-schema registry
fields.verification: Must match the active kernel schema and field catalog.
fields.mutability: Immutable for the capsule after open.
fields.failure_condition: Unknown or mismatched version blocks schema compliance.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Genesis Edge
fields.purpose: Declare the typed scope relationship from the capsule to CAP-000.
fields.source: Constitutional genesis rule
fields.verification: VGATE-R verifies registered type, direction, and active status.
fields.mutability: Immutable after open.
fields.failure_condition: Missing, untyped, or altered genesis relation blocks authority and closure.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Name
fields.purpose: Provide the human handle attached to the active scoped execution declaration.
fields.source: Active scope and governing subroutine declaration
fields.cardinality: Exactly one value in the current canonical schema.
fields.verification: Must remain consistent with Scope, PATH, and Subroutine.
fields.mutability: May change only through a governed scope or subroutine correction before reasoning.
fields.failure_condition: Missing value or silent disagreement with active scope fails schema review.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.
fields.notes: The canonical schema contains two fields labeled Name. This catalog assigns separate stable IDs and occurrence numbers without silently changing the schema.

fields.label: Scope
fields.purpose: Bound the domain in which the capsule may reason and act.
fields.source: Resolved intent, PATH, and governing subroutine
fields.verification: Must not silently cross a domain boundary; a crossing requires routing and subroutine governance.
fields.mutability: Change requires a logged routing event before affected reasoning proceeds.
fields.failure_condition: Missing or silently expanded scope causes governance failure.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Goal
fields.purpose: State the single resolved outcome the capsule is trying to reach.
fields.source: Resolved User Intent and active constraints
fields.verification: Must be traceable to User Intent and satisfy ICL.
fields.mutability: A material goal change requires re-resolution and an Audit Log event.
fields.failure_condition: Multiple active goals or an untraceable goal blocks reasoning.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Constraints
fields.purpose: Declare every active rule that bounds admissible reasoning and output.
fields.source: Constitutional state, sealed ledger, current user instruction, and applicable domain rules
fields.cardinality: One field containing zero or more declared constraints.
fields.verification: Factual constraints pass VGATE; logical rules pass structural compliance.
fields.mutability: Append or revise only through a logged constraint event before closure.
fields.failure_condition: Omitted material constraint or unverified factual constraint blocks closure.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Subroutine
fields.purpose: Declare the active Mode 1 interface and any cleared Mode 2 load.
fields.source: PATH-governed Mode 1 registry and DSS synthesis or tool gate
fields.cardinality: Exactly one Mode 1 declaration and at most one capsule-scoped Mode 2 declaration.
fields.verification: Mode 1 must be registered; Mode 2 must clear SYNTHESIS_GATE or registered-tool validation.
fields.mutability: Mode 1 changes only through governed swap; Mode 2 purges from active state at closure.
fields.failure_condition: Unknown interface, uncleared load, or silent PATH change blocks reasoning or closure.
fields.display: Projected in the concise DSS state strip and explicit capsule output.

fields.label: PATH
fields.purpose: Locate the capsule in the governed DEX namespace.
fields.source: Domain, subdomain, context, and folder governance
fields.verification: DEX verifies hierarchy and routes unresolved capsules to /ROOT/UNCLASSIFIED.
fields.mutability: A domain-boundary change requires a logged route and subroutine swap.
fields.failure_condition: Orphaned or silently changed location causes routing failure.
fields.display: Always projected in the mini-map.

fields.label: RUNN Decision
fields.purpose: Record the governed capsule topology and the rule that selected it.
fields.source: CAP-000-RTDT and current problem structure
fields.cardinality: Exactly one initial topology decision; later changes are logged separately.
fields.verification: Topology must match a registered decision-table condition.
fields.mutability: A topology change requires an Audit Log event and preserves the initial decision.
fields.failure_condition: Undocumented or incompatible topology blocks compliant execution.
fields.display: Topology is projected in the mini-map.

fields.label: KRONOS
fields.purpose: Record chain-continuity and Alpha/Beta/Gamma authority calibration.
fields.source: Parent lineage, Genesis state, sealed ledger, and current input
fields.verification: Parent identity and hash must match the latest sealed ledger entry.
fields.mutability: Immutable after pre-reasoning continuity check unless the capsule reopens.
fields.failure_condition: Chain failure or silent authority inversion blocks reasoning and closure.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Facts
fields.purpose: Hold the bounded verified factual state permitted to influence reasoning.
fields.source: Verified external sources, sealed capsules, or authoritative user testimony under DEFER_USER
fields.grammar: At most five verified facts; slots four and five may contain labeled overflow or composites; divergences are flagged inline.
fields.verification: VGATE threshold applies before entry; volatile facts require Path A and Path B.
fields.mutability: Facts may be added, corrected, or retracted only with logged verification events before closure.
fields.failure_condition: Unverified, over-capacity, or silently divergent fact state blocks closure.
fields.display: Only verified facts may be compiled into output; full field remains internal by default.

fields.label: Closure Condition
fields.purpose: State the explicit condition that permits or prevents capsule closure.
fields.source: Active hypotheses, novelty state, facts, and constraints
fields.grammar: One explicit line naming the satisfied or unsatisfied stop condition.
fields.verification: Must agree with Closure Formula and Closure Proof.
fields.mutability: May change while the capsule remains open; immutable at seal.
fields.failure_condition: Implicit or inconsistent closure condition blocks sealing.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Closure Formula
fields.purpose: Identify the formal closure witness used by RUNN.
fields.source: RUNN expansion check
fields.grammar: dH/dt=0 | Pk(H)=0 | novelty=0 | COMPOSITE | NONE CLOSED.
fields.verification: The selected formula must be supported by Closure Proof.
fields.mutability: May change while open; immutable at seal.
fields.failure_condition: Unsupported formula or false zero-state blocks closure.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Closure Proof
fields.purpose: Name the verified fact or constraint that makes the closure formula true.
fields.source: Facts, constraints, and logged hypothesis elimination
fields.grammar: Specific witness; for NONE CLOSED, state why every closure formula failed.
fields.verification: Must trace to fields already present in the capsule or sealed ledger.
fields.mutability: May be revised before closure challenge resolves; immutable at seal.
fields.failure_condition: Circular, absent, or untraceable proof blocks closure.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Residue Type
fields.purpose: Classify the epistemic authority remaining at closure.
fields.source: Closure, verification, contradiction, and supersession state
fields.verification: KNOWLEDGE requires closed prediction space and successful verification; other values follow their governing conditions.
fields.mutability: Immutable in the sealed capsule; later capsules may supersede or retract through typed relations.
fields.failure_condition: Overstated authority or value outside the registry blocks seal.
fields.display: Projected in the mini-map and may be compiled into transparency output.

fields.label: Knowledge Residue
fields.purpose: Store the immutable post-closure knowledge statement when Residue Type is KNOWLEDGE.
fields.source: Verified closed capsule state
fields.grammar: Concise immutable output; populated only for KNOWLEDGE.
fields.cardinality: Exactly one field; empty or N/A for non-KNOWLEDGE residue.
fields.verification: Must be entailed by Facts, Constraints, Closure Proof, and successful audits.
fields.mutability: Immutable after seal.
fields.failure_condition: Populating it from an open prediction or unsupported statement blocks seal.
fields.display: Primary ledger content available to SOC for compilation.

fields.label: VERIFY Events
fields.purpose: Record eliminative verification paths and their outcomes.
fields.source: Path A sources and Path B sealed-state or mesh checks
fields.grammar: Path A, Path B deductive, and Path B inductive events with claim and pass/fail marker.
fields.cardinality: Path B only for eligible single-source turns; Path A plus Path B for volatile claims.
fields.verification: Events must identify the claim, source class, and outcome; divergence is explicit.
fields.mutability: Append-only during reasoning and immutable at seal.
fields.failure_condition: Missing required path or silent path divergence blocks KNOWLEDGE closure.
fields.display: Verified claims may be projected in output; raw event list remains internal by default.

fields.label: Witness Signal
fields.purpose: Emit one non-deliberative observation flag over the reasoning arc.
fields.source: Observed topology, facts, constraints, and execution arc
fields.cardinality: Exactly one mutually exclusive signal and no prose.
fields.verification: VGATE reviews any non-CLEAR signal and requires resolution before closure.
fields.mutability: May change only after a logged revisit resolves the observed condition.
fields.failure_condition: Missing, multiple, prose-expanded, or unresolved non-CLEAR signal blocks seal.
fields.display: May be projected as a status glyph; full field appears in explicit capsule output.
fields.notes: Replaces the v3.3 Witness Log and Witness Sign-off fields at the same schema position.

fields.label: Insight
fields.purpose: State the structural lever derived from verified facts.
fields.source: Facts processed through the active subroutine under Constraints
fields.verification: Logic Debugger Fact→Insight must pass; no absent fact may support it.
fields.mutability: Discarded and regenerated during FRP; immutable after successful closure.
fields.failure_condition: Unsupported or overlength insight triggers Logic Debugger fault.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state is explicitly requested.

fields.label: Directive
fields.purpose: Express the enforceable action that follows from the verified insight.
fields.source: Insight, active Constraints, and resolved User Intent
fields.verification: VSP Clause 4, Logic Debugger, and the pre-seal adversarial check must pass.
fields.mutability: Discarded and regenerated during FRP; immutable after seal.
fields.failure_condition: Harm-adjacent unresolved, non-sequitur, contradictory, or overlength directive blocks output.
fields.display: Primary actionable source available to SOC after closure.

fields.label: Logic Debugger
fields.purpose: Audit Fact→Insight, Insight→Governance, and Insight→Directive continuity.
fields.source: Facts, Insight, Constraints, Governance, and Directive
fields.grammar: Fact→Insight PASS/FAULT; Insight→Gov PASS/FAULT; Insight→Directive PASS/FAULT.
fields.verification: All axes must PASS; any FAULT activates FRP.
fields.mutability: Re-run after each FRP attempt; all attempts remain auditable.
fields.failure_condition: Unresolved FAULT halts closure and may produce FAULT_UNRESOLVED.
fields.display: Internal except transparency output for unresolved faults.

fields.label: Governance
fields.purpose: Declare escalation, reopen, TTL, and topology controls applicable after formation.
fields.source: Active kernel rules and capsule-specific risk conditions
fields.grammar: Escalation rules, reopen triggers, TTL configuration, and Topology: LOCAL_MESH | ISOLATED | MERKLE_CHILD.
fields.verification: Must not conflict with Constraints, RUNN topology, or constitutional authority.
fields.mutability: May be refined before closure with an Audit Log event; immutable at seal.
fields.failure_condition: Missing escalation path or governance conflict blocks closure.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state or operational governance is requested.

fields.label: Ops
fields.purpose: Translate the directive into an engine-ready imperative.
fields.source: Directive and Governance
fields.verification: Must remain within user authorization and active governance.
fields.mutability: May change with Directive before closure; immutable at seal.
fields.failure_condition: Imperative exceeding authority or diverging from Directive blocks execution.
fields.display: Internal unless operational handoff is required.

fields.label: Audit Log
fields.purpose: Preserve significant execution events without exposing hidden deliberation.
fields.source: Constraint, verification, topology, routing, relation, fault, and closure events
fields.cardinality: One append-only field containing zero or more significant events.
fields.verification: Events must be factual, timestamped, and within the emitting component's jurisdiction.
fields.mutability: Append-only; prior events cannot be rewritten.
fields.failure_condition: Silent material transition or rewritten event invalidates audit compliance.
fields.display: Internal unless audit or transparency output is requested.

fields.label: Capsule Status
fields.purpose: Record the capsule's current governed lifecycle state.
fields.source: Capsule state machine
fields.grammar: OPEN | CLOSURE_PROPOSED | CLOSURE_CHALLENGED | CLOSURE_FAILED | CLOSED | FORCE_SEALED | HANDOFF_TERMINATED | CLOSED (PARTIAL_MERKLE) | HALTED | FAULT_UNRESOLVED | ORPHANED.
fields.cardinality: Exactly one current value with transitions preserved in Capsule History.
fields.verification: Transition must be legal under the capsule state machine.
fields.mutability: Current value advances through legal transitions; sealed history is append-only.
fields.failure_condition: Illegal or unlogged transition blocks closure.
fields.display: Status glyph may be projected; full value appears in explicit capsule output.

fields.label: Capsule Closed
fields.purpose: Record the exact time closure completed.
fields.source: Runtime clock at successful seal
fields.cardinality: Exactly one closure timestamp for a closed capsule.
fields.verification: Must follow Received and agree with the final CLOSED history event.
fields.mutability: Written once at closure and immutable thereafter.
fields.failure_condition: Premature, missing, or inconsistent closure time blocks a valid seal.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule or audit state is requested.

fields.label: Capsule History
fields.purpose: Preserve every capsule state transition in order.
fields.source: Capsule state machine
fields.grammar: STATE → ISO 8601 entries in append-only order.
fields.cardinality: One append-only list with at least OPEN and the current terminal or active state.
fields.verification: Transitions and timestamps must be legal and monotonic.
fields.mutability: Append-only.
fields.failure_condition: Missing, reordered, or rewritten transition invalidates lifecycle evidence.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule or audit state is requested.

fields.label: Mesh Edges
fields.purpose: Store typed capsule-to-capsule relations used by the local knowledge mesh.
fields.source: Declared, inherited, imported, or compression-surviving relations
fields.grammar: SOURCE_CAP → TARGET_CAP | registered TYPE | status: ACTIVE/RESOLVED/INACTIVE/TRANSIENT | provenance: LOCAL/INHERITED/IMPORTED/COMPRESSED.
fields.cardinality: Zero or more canonical relation records.
fields.verification: VGATE-R verifies direction, type, status, and provenance before entry and after compression or pruning.
fields.mutability: Append-only relation history; status may advance through registered transitions.
fields.failure_condition: Untyped, ambiguous, invalid-status, or collapsed relation blocks inference and closure.
fields.display: Edge count may be projected; records appear in explicit capsule output.

fields.label: Mesh Resolution
fields.purpose: Record the required reconciliation of a TENSIONS_WITH relation.
fields.source: Both capsules participating in the tension
fields.grammar: Reconciliation statement plus RECONCILED | FORK | ONE_SUPERSEDES_OTHER.
fields.cardinality: Required for every TENSIONS_WITH edge; otherwise explicit N/A is permitted.
fields.verification: Both affected capsules must log the same outcome before either seals.
fields.mutability: May evolve while tension is active; immutable after mutual resolution and seal.
fields.failure_condition: Unresolved or asymmetric tension blocks both capsules from sealing.
fields.display: Internal unless capsule state or tension resolution is requested.

fields.label: [LINKS]
fields.purpose: Store typed non-linear logic movement between capsules.
fields.source: Governed branch, convergence, and synthesis topology
fields.grammar: SOURCE_CAP → TARGET_CAP | BRANCHES_TO | CONVERGES_FROM | SYNTHESIZES | status: ACTIVE/RESOLVED/INACTIVE/TRANSIENT | provenance.
fields.cardinality: Zero or more canonical DAG relation records.
fields.verification: VGATE-R verifies registered DAG type, direction, status, and provenance.
fields.mutability: Append-only relation history; branch status may become INACTIVE after closure.
fields.failure_condition: Untyped, collapsed, or semantically mismatched DAG link blocks dependent inference.
fields.display: Link count or nested children may be projected; records appear in explicit capsule output.

fields.label: Tags
fields.purpose: Attach governed thematic identity without asserting structural or causal relations.
fields.source: Folder axiom for Slot 1 and grounded active Tag Registry entries for Slots 2–5
fields.grammar: Slot 1 optional structural #snake_case tag; Slots 2–5 grounded minted #snake_case tags; maximum five total.
fields.cardinality: Zero to five tags, with at most one structural tag.
fields.verification: DEX alone writes Slot 1; every minted tag passes TAG-VGATE and TARS.
fields.mutability: Compiled at closure and immutable in the sealed capsule; registry history remains append-only.
fields.failure_condition: Freeform, ungrounded, inactive, over-budget, or PATH-derived tag fails closure.
fields.display: Active mode and selected tags may be projected; full field appears in explicit capsule output.

fields.label: VSP_Status
fields.purpose: Record deterministic verification sufficiency for seal and later recall.
fields.source: Logged VGATE decisions, VERIFY Events, and Clause 4 outcome
fields.verification: Aggregate existing logs using precedence UNVERIFIED → N/A → PARTIAL → VERIFIED; perform no new verification at seal.
fields.mutability: Written once at closure and immutable thereafter.
fields.failure_condition: Missing intake evidence, wrong precedence, or inferred repair at seal invalidates the status and can block SOC.
fields.display: May be surfaced on recall or when verification state affects output.

fields.label: SHA-256
fields.purpose: Seal the complete preceding capsule field state as Proof of Thought.
fields.source: Canonical serialization of fields 1 through 42
fields.cardinality: Exactly one digest on successful closure.
fields.verification: Recompute over every preceding field in canonical order and require an exact match.
fields.mutability: Created only at closure and immutable thereafter.
fields.failure_condition: Absent, malformed, or mismatched digest means no valid PoT exists and closure fails.
fields.display: Four-character PoT projection appears in the mini-map; full digest belongs to the sealed record.
